tests.name: process driver against the press simulator (ebmr.sim-process.v1) > [DI-32] verifies the serial at connect, reads every press tag as decimal text in its unit, writes a setpoint and reads it back
process driver against the press simulator (ebmr.sim-process.v1) > refuses a device that reports another serial or another kind of equipment (SERIAL_MISMATCH, alarmed)
process driver against the press simulator (ebmr.sim-process.v1) > a garbled answer is never read: PROTOCOL, alarmed, and the next read runs on a fresh connection
process driver against the press simulator (ebmr.sim-process.v1) > OFFLINE: the connection drops, reads answer OFFLINE, and the driver reconnects when the device is back

process uplink (POST /gw/v1/process-readings, setpoint downloads) under the gateway session > [DI-31] sends each value with its provenance in the exact wire shape: device serial, tag, decimal value, unit, quality, source time, per-device sequence, kind

process uplink (POST /gw/v1/process-readings, setpoint downloads) under the gateway session > [DI-31] stores and forwards: an outage loses nothing, the readings follow in order once the server is back, and across a gateway restart
process uplink (POST /gw/v1/process-readings, setpoint downloads) under the gateway session > a session the server ended is logged in again and the readings go under the new token

process uplink (POST /gw/v1/process-readings, setpoint downloads) under the gateway session > reports STALE quality once the scan counter has not moved for the stale time, and GOOD again when it moves
process uplink (POST /gw/v1/process-readings, setpoint downloads) under the gateway session > forwards an alarm on the main force as ALARM with the value then, and ALARM_CLEARED when it ends

process uplink (POST /gw/v1/process-readings, setpoint downloads) under the gateway session > downloads a setpoint, reads it back, forwards the read-back before the acknowledgement: APPLIED, MISMATCH, FAILED
process uplink (POST /gw/v1/process-readings, setpoint downloads) under the gateway session > an acknowledgement that does not reach the server is sent again without writing the device again
the OPC UA client driver > [DI-20] reports each session first, with the certificate presented, the location the server states and the units; then subscribes the released tags
the OPC UA client driver > [DI-20] a changed certificate: nothing is read, the session is reported once with the certificate presented, the state and an alarm say why; retried
the OPC UA client driver > [DI-32] samples become numbered, hashed chunks with source times, raw text and status as received; the process view shows the raw value exactly
